name: get_capabilities
description: Discover actual tools, supported workflows, runtime readiness and limits before editing.
signature: () -> dict

name: read_guide
description: Read the exact supported timeline contract and editing workflow; do not guess parameters.
signature: (topic: Literal['agent', 'timeline', 'effects', 'compatibility', 'tool-audit', 'comfy-models', 'comfy-apps', 'scene3d', 'composition', 'release-tools', 'hdr', 'animation', 'webgl'] = 'agent') -> dict

name: create_project
description: Create a fresh editing project. Existing projects are never replaced.
signature: (name: str, project_id: str | None = None) -> dict

name: get_project
description: Read media IDs, the current timeline and its revision for conflict-safe saving.
signature: (project_id: str) -> dict

name: inspect_media
description: Inspect a local media file's duration, dimensions, rates and streams without changing it.
signature: (source: str) -> dict

name: preview_source
description: See source frames at explicit times BEFORE choosing shots. Request up to 12 times.
signature: (project_id: str, source: str, times: list[float]) -> dict

name: view_image
description: View a saved image or matte inside the project. Path is relative to that project.
signature: (project_id: str, path: str) -> dict

name: import_media
description:
Import media, optionally a trimmed/resized video excerpt or its audio. Originals stay untouched.

Inspect first; use a short excerpt to avoid extracting an entire long video.
Rights records are provenance, not legal clearance. HDR/rotation need explicit conformance.
signature: (project_id: str, source: str, rights: str = 'review_pending', start: float = 0, duration: float | None = None, max_width: int | None = None, audio_only: bool = False) -> dict

name: plan_edit
description: Optional original recipe starting point. Returns a timeline for the agent to edit; does not save it.
signature: (project_id: str, asset_ids: list[str], recipe: str = 'Drift', seconds: float = 3, width: int = 1280, height: int = 720, fps: float = 30, caption: str = '') -> dict

name: validate_timeline
description: Check a complete timeline against real local assets before saving or rendering.
signature: (project_id: str, timeline: dict) -> dict

name: save_timeline
description: Save the agent's authored timeline; pass the revision from get_project (null for first save).
signature: (project_id: str, timeline: dict, revision: str | None) -> dict

name: preview_timeline
description: See actual rendered frames of the saved timeline, including text/masks/camera/effects.
signature: (project_id: str, frames: list[int]) -> dict

name: start_render
description: Render a saved timeline asynchronously. Reuse request_id after uncertain results to avoid duplicate jobs.
signature: (project_id: str, request_id: str) -> dict

name: get_render
description: Read a recorded render status and output path, also after MCP reconnects. Never resubmits.
signature: (project_id: str, job_id: str) -> dict

name: review_render
description: Record the agent's review against rendered source/timeline hashes. Does not publish or imply human approval.
signature: (project_id: str, job_id: str, decision: Literal['approved', 'changes_requested'], notes: str) -> dict

name: analyze_clip
description:
Run local source analysis. Preview results; apply=true saves a new timeline revision.

masks options: mode (chroma, luma, alpha, grabcut, refine), key, tolerance, softness, rect, feather;
mode refine (an existing matte): grow (px, - shrinks), feather, fill_holes, smooth (frames), keep_largest. faces: min_size,
detector (auto: the bundled YuNet model with eyes, nose tip and mouth corners; cascade: OpenCV cascades, eyes
only), cascade (a classifier file, cascade detector). interpolate: multiplier. retime (slow motion as a plate with
one new picture per output frame): start, seconds (clip source interval), output_frames, fps (default the
canvas fps), take_start/take_seconds (one take; cuts inside are refused), deduplicate (collapse baked repeats,
run-centre timing), duplicate_threshold; returns a new clip to add and use at speed 1 from src 0 (apply is not
available for retime). No models are automatically downloaded.
signature: (project_id: str, clip_id: str, operation: Literal['masks', 'faces', 'interpolate', 'retime'], options: dict | None = None, apply: bool = False) -> dict

name: build_workflow
description: Build an audited LOCAL workflow with explicit installed model names; returns a project-relative file.
signature: (project_id: str, kind: Literal['matte', 'segmentation', 'interpolation', 'generation', 'qwen-generation', 'h3-generation', 'cutout', 'qwen-edit', 'h3-reference', 'seedvr2-restore', 'model-interpolation', 'image-upscale'], parameters: dict | None = None) -> dict

name: check_workflow
description:
Check local nodes/models without execution. For imported API workflows, reviewed_local_nodes
extends this workflow's supported nodes after inspecting their implementation for local-only,
no-download behavior. It never permits partner API nodes. See the comfy-models guide.
signature: (project_id: str, workflow: str, native_endpoint: str = 'http://127.0.0.1:8000', reviewed_local_nodes: list[str] | None = None) -> dict

name: submit_workflow
description:
Submit through official Comfy SDK. assets maps NODE.INPUT to project-relative files.

Use a stable request_id. Existing receipts are returned, including unknown submission
outcomes; the server never blindly retries them. Local is the default. For paid workflows,
use execution=cloud, endpoint=https://cloud.comfy.org and allow_paid=true only after
user authorization for the job and media upload. COMFY_API_KEY comes from the environment.
Supply an API-format workflow supported by Comfy Cloud; build_workflow remains local.
Imported local workflows may supply reviewed_local_nodes after source/schema inspection
establishes no paid calls or automatic downloads. The extension is recorded in the receipt.
signature: (project_id: str, workflow: str, request_id: str, assets: dict[str, str] | None = None, endpoint: str = 'http://127.0.0.1:8189', native_endpoint: str = 'http://127.0.0.1:8000', execution: Literal['local', 'cloud'] = 'local', allow_paid: bool = False, reviewed_local_nodes: list[str] | None = None) -> dict

name: collect_workflow
description: Collect the previously submitted Comfy job; never submit a replacement.
signature: (project_id: str, directory: str) -> dict

name: import_workflow_output
description: Import collected images/masks or one video/audio output. Select output_file for mixed outputs.
signature: (project_id: str, directory: str, kind: Literal['clip', 'mask'] = 'clip', clip_id: str | None = None, fps: float = 30, output_file: str | None = None) -> dict

name: process_clip
description:
Advance a resumable whole-clip Comfy sequence. Reuse directory and settings to collect/continue.

cutout: point-click subject cut-out. points/negative_points are [x, y] clicks in 0..1 coordinates of the clip's
first frame (on / off the subject); a SAM2 video model (model, e.g. sam2.1_hiera_base_plus.safetensors, must
already be installed) carries the selection through the clip in one job and the masks become the clip's mask_dir
after review. Preview the first frame (preview_source) to place the clicks.
signature: (project_id: str, clip_id: str, kind: Literal['matte', 'segmentation', 'interpolation', 'cutout'], directory: str, endpoint: str = 'http://127.0.0.1:8189', native_endpoint: str = 'http://127.0.0.1:8000', model: str | None = None, points: list[list[float]] | None = None, negative_points: list[list[float]] | None = None) -> dict

name: source_contact_sheet
description: Inspect up to 96 timestamped source frames as contact sheets. Use smaller intervals around cut candidates.
signature: (project_id: str, source: str, start: float = 0, end: float | None = None, step: float = 0.5, columns: int = 4) -> dict

name: analyze_reference
description: Find scene-change and audio energy-rise candidates in up to 120 seconds. These are NOT verified cuts/beats/lyrics.
signature: (project_id: str, source: str, start: float = 0, duration: float = 30, scene_threshold: float = 0.25) -> dict

name: list_fonts
description:
List actual local font family/style/path metadata. Use a supplied folder for project fonts. No downloads or automatic matching.
With `text`, each font reports the characters it lacks (`missing`) and whether it `covers` the text.
signature: (directory: str | None = None, query: str = '', limit: int = 100, text: str | None = None) -> dict

name: preview_fonts
description: See side-by-side specimens and exact hashes of up to eight local TTF/OTF/TTC font files before choosing one (TTC: first face, as browsers load it).
signature: (project_id: str, sources: list[str], text: str = 'AFTER HOURS') -> dict

name: preview_segment
description: Create a playable video excerpt (up to 15s) and an audio preview for clients supporting audio input. Never claim listening from metadata.
signature: (project_id: str, source: str, start: float = 0, duration: float = 5, max_width: int = 960) -> dict

name: compare_reference
description: See paired reference/render pictures at the same requested times (render time = reference time + offset).
signature: (project_id: str, reference: str, rendered: str, times: list[float], render_offset: float = 0) -> dict

name: save_reference_plan
description: Record verified reference timing/text/font/effect requirements. Read tool-audit guide for schema. Render blocks mismatches; do not invent or silently weaken requirements.
signature: (project_id: str, plan: dict) -> dict

name: audit_reference_plan
description: Check saved timeline against exact cut frames, literal timed text, font file hashes and specified shot settings.
signature: (project_id: str) -> dict

name: import_media_batch
description: Import 1..32 excerpts, hashing a large source once. Each excerpt has start/duration and optional max_width/audio_only. Repeated request IDs return recorded partial/completed results without duplicating imports.
signature: (project_id: str, source: str, excerpts: list[dict], request_id: str, rights: str = 'review_pending') -> dict

name: analyze_audio
description:
Measure music for cutting: BPM with octave candidates, a constant beat grid fitted to onsets, downbeats, onsets
(all/strong/low), level-based sections, silence and EBU R128 loudness, plus a timeline image. Times are seconds
from `start`; pass fps for frame numbers. Estimates for planning cuts, not verified musical structure.
signature: (project_id: str, source: str, start: float = 0, duration: float | None = None, fps: float | None = None, beats_per_bar: int = 4) -> dict

name: analyze_energy
description:
Measure a video's energy: cuts, white/black flashes, shake bursts, pans and motion hits (each with a ready
timeline entry: specials / cam.shake / cam.pan / cam.punch), per-second rates and a 0.5 s energy curve, plus a
chart image. With `reference`, also measure it and check the source's rates against it (FAIL below floor x the
reference, or too much shake/jitter). Event times are seconds of the file; amplitudes are px of a canvas_w canvas.
signature: (project_id: str, source: str, reference: str | None = None, start: float = 0, duration: float | None = None, canvas_w: int = 1080, floor: float = 0.6) -> dict

name: plan_music_edit
description:
Plan cuts to music: analyse the track, then return a beat-aligned cut list (tempo-aware pace per level section:
the smallest of 1/2/4/8 beats lasting >= 0.5 s loud, 1 s mid, 2 s quiet; half-beat burst after a drop), shot spans, suggested specials/punch/shake entries and,
with asset_ids, a draft timeline (clips assigned in order; the track is included when it lives in the project).
A starting point for the editor; nothing is saved.
signature: (project_id: str, source: str, asset_ids: list[str] | None = None, start: float = 0, duration: float | None = None, fps: float = 30, width: int = 1080, height: int = 1920, pace: str = 'auto', min_shot: float = 0.15, burst: bool = True) -> dict

name: make_captions
description:
Turn supplied word timings (words JSON or SRT/VTT; no transcription) into caption text events for the timeline,
grouped for reading (max_chars/max_words/max_gap/max_duration, sentence ends), in a style (clean, bold_pop,
karaoke with per-word highlight, lower_third, title_card), plus SRT and WebVTT files. `offset` subtracts seconds
(e.g. the audio start used in the timeline). Insert the events into the timeline's `text` yourself.
signature: (project_id: str, words: str, family: str, fps: float = 30, style: str = 'clean', size: int | None = None, height: int = 1080, offset: float = 0, highlight: str = '#ffd200', karaoke_mode: str = 'word', max_chars: int = 32, max_words: int = 7, max_gap: float = 0.6, max_duration: float = 3) -> dict

name: list_sfx
description:
Browse OpenKatana's own synthesised sound effects (no recordings or licences involved): name, category,
variants, duration and default level. Place them with timeline audio.cues [{sfx, variant, at, level_db}].
signature: (category: str | None = None) -> dict

name: set_review_policy
description:
Optional strict mode: start_render then refuses until every source used by the timeline was inspected
(preview_source / source_contact_sheet) and the current revision was previewed (preview_timeline); with
require_motion also until revise_motion measured the current revision against a reference.
signature: (project_id: str, strict: bool, require_motion: bool | None = None) -> dict

name: render_page
signature: (project_id: str, page: str, frames: int | None = None, fps: float | None = None) -> dict

name: build_recipe
description:
Starting-point timeline for one of 8 recipe families (beat_cut_punch, xerox_ink, mono_noir, cutout_collage,
speed_ramp_freeze, facelock_strobe, timed_type, glitch_hits) from imported assets; music (an imported audio
asset) drives beat-based families. `family` may also be one of OpenKatana's 12 presets (get_capabilities
presets: a family plus a look and finishing, e.g. neon-beat, travel-diary). Returned validated, not saved; the
editor adapts it.
signature: (project_id: str, family: str, asset_ids: list[str], music_asset_id: str | None = None, text: str | None = None, font_family: str | None = None, font_file: str | None = None, seconds: float = 6, width: int = 1080, height: int = 1920, fps: float = 30) -> dict

name: revise_motion
description:
Bounded motion revision loop: render the saved timeline, measure per-second cuts, flashes, shake frames,
jitter, camera movement and motion energy against a reference video (analyze_energy measures), then up to
max_revisions (0-4) times propose camera-only edits on unlocked shots (shake bursts, pans, punch hits at the
reference's event times; amplitude scaling bounded 0.5-2x per step), re-render and re-measure; the best attempt
is kept. Clips, shot spans, sources, transitions, flashes, text, looks, post and audio never change; cut/flash
shortfalls are listed for the editor. ceiling (e.g. 2) also fails camera movement / motion energy above
ceiling x the reference and scales camera moves down (0.5x minimum per step). apply=true saves the best
attempt only if it scores better. Records the
assessment for the strict review gate. Slow: one full render per attempt.
signature: (project_id: str, reference: str, max_revisions: int = 2, locked_shots: list[int] | None = None, floor: float = 0.6, reference_start: float = 0, reference_duration: float | None = None, apply: bool = False, ceiling: float | None = None) -> dict

name: review_mask
description:
Review a clip's matte: sheets of the source every `step` s plus the last frame with the background tinted, the
matte edge outlined and coverage per frame; flags empty/full mattes and coverage jumps. Look at the sheets, then
call again with accept true/false to record the decision (strict mode blocks matte-dependent renders - cutout,
outline, contour, contour_glow, cut-out stickers - until the current matte is accepted).
signature: (project_id: str, clip_id: str, step: float = 0.25, accept: bool | None = None, note: str = '') -> dict

name: bind_reference
description:
Record a named reference (role identity, style, product or location) from imported assets, with their hashes.
In strict review mode, generated material (clips imported from a Comfy job) must then be accepted against every
identity reference with inspect_identity before it renders.
signature: (project_id: str, name: str, asset_ids: list[str], role: str = 'identity', subject_type: str = 'person', description: str = '') -> dict

name: inspect_identity
description:
Compare an asset with bound references: a sheet of the largest detected face (or the centre) in each reference
and in the chosen frames of the asset. Visual comparison only - no biometric identity score. Look at the sheet,
then call again with accept true/false to record the decision used by the strict review gate.
signature: (project_id: str, asset_id: str, references: list[str] | None = None, frames: list[int] | None = None, accept: bool | None = None, note: str = '') -> dict

name: transcribe_audio
description:
Transcribe speech locally with word timings (faster-whisper; a Whisper model already in the local cache, see
get_capabilities transcription; never downloaded). Writes a words file for make_captions; times are seconds of
the source file. Machine output: check words, names and timings against the audio before captioning.
signature: (project_id: str, source: str, model: str | None = None, language: str | None = None, start: float = 0, duration: float | None = None) -> dict

name: plan_storyboard
description:
Storyboard mode: plan a music edit as slots to fill before footage exists. Each beat-aligned slot gets a brief
(part, role, shot size, subject, camera, seconds of footage needed) and a slate picture, so the draft timeline
renders for review. save=true makes it the project timeline. The verdict stays "GAPS storyboard: k of n slots
still to fill" until fill_storyboard puts imported footage into every slot.
signature: (project_id: str, source: str, start: float = 0, duration: float | None = None, fps: float = 30, width: int = 1080, height: int = 1920, pace: str = 'auto', subject: str = 'the main subject', camera: str | None = None, save: bool = False) -> dict

name: fill_storyboard
description:
Put imported footage into storyboard slots of the saved timeline (fills: [{slot, asset_id, srcf?}]; each
slot's other shot settings are kept) and save a new revision. Video slots need enough footage from srcf. With no
fills, only report the verdict: "GAPS storyboard: k of n slots still to fill" with the briefs, or "FILLED".
signature: (project_id: str, storyboard_id: str, fills: list[dict] | None = None) -> dict

name: create_scene3d
description: Create an editable 3D scene, never overwrite one. Read scene3d guide. Optional scene is a complete schema-1 scene; asset paths are relative to scenes/NAME/.
signature: (project_id: str, name: str = 'scene', template: Literal['product', 'morph', 'physics'] = 'product', scene: dict | None = None) -> dict

name: inspect_model3d
description: Inspect a supplied local GLB/glTF model's clips, skins, morph targets and dependencies. No import, generation or download.
signature: (source: str) -> dict

name: import_model3d
description: Copy a supplied GLB/glTF and its local dependencies into a NEW project-relative folder, normally scenes/NAME/assets/MODEL. Rights remain the user's responsibility.
signature: (project_id: str, source: str, destination: str) -> dict

name: check_scene3d
description: Validate scene JSON, animation targets, local model dependencies and supported fields before rendering. Does not establish visual quality.
signature: (project_id: str, scene: str) -> dict

name: render_scene3d
description: Render WebGL 3D locally with reverse-seek checks. Preview stills or an inclusive start/end chunk; omit range for full clip. Custom ES modules need trusted_script=true after review. Returns PNG clip, optional MP4 and a receipt usable by assemble_render_clips. No model services or Blender required.
signature: (project_id: str, scene: str, preview_frames: list[int] | None = None, video: bool = True, start: int | None = None, end: int | None = None, trusted_script: bool = False) -> dict

name: render_blender
description: Render a project .blend or explicitly trusted .py scene script using separately installed Blender. Full Blender geometry/material/rigging/simulation authoring is available to scripts; this is NOT a security sandbox. Returns PNG clip and MP4. No automatic downloads or services.
signature: (project_id: str, source: str, engine: Literal['BLENDER_EEVEE', 'CYCLES'] = 'BLENDER_EEVEE', start: int | None = None, end: int | None = None, trusted_script: bool = False) -> dict

name: morph_images
description: Morph two local images using geometric ORB correspondence or explicit normalized landmarks. Refuses unreliable matches/folded triangles. Returns an editable correspondence receipt and timeline clip; not semantic video generation.
signature: (project_id: str, source: str, target: str, width: int = 512, height: int = 512, fps: int = 30, frames: int = 60, points: dict | None = None) -> dict

name: shape_text
description: Export one shaped text run as glyph IDs, clusters, positions, contours and SVG. Requires the licensed text extra. For paragraph bidi/fallback use compositions.
signature: (project_id: str, font: str, text: str, size: float = 72, direction: Optional[Literal['ltr', 'rtl', 'ttb', 'btt']] = None, language: str = 'und', script: str | None = None, features: dict | None = None, variations: dict | None = None, radius: float | None = None) -> dict

name: edit_timeline
description: Propose or atomically save RFC 6902 timeline operations against an exact revision. Default is a validated proposal. Whole-batch failure leaves the project unchanged.
signature: (project_id: str, operations: list[dict], revision: str, save: bool = False) -> dict

name: import_hdr_media
description:
Keep an original HDR source and import an explicitly tone-mapped SDR editing proxy.

Returns an HDR finishing document referencing the untouched source copy. Ordinary
Canvas timelines use the proxy; render_hdr preserves source highlight precision.
signature: (project_id: str, source: str, source_color: Optional[Literal['pq', 'hlg', 'bt709', 'srgb']] = None, fps: int = 30, start: float = 0, duration: float = 3, peak_nits: float = 1000, rights: str = 'review_pending') -> dict

name: render_hdr
description:
Finish HDR clips in float32 linear BT.2020; export 16-bit FFV1, 10-bit HEVC and SDR preview.

Uses the separate openkatana.hdr/1 contract (hdr guide). Supports trims, scaling,
exposure, linear dissolves and explicit sRGB PNG overlays. Canvas effects are SDR.
signature: (project_id: str, document: dict) -> dict

name: run_model_workflow
description:
Build, check, submit or collect an installed LOCAL model workflow with stable request ID.

assets must bind every returned build_workflow asset port to a project-relative file.
Repeating identical arguments collects the original job; it never resubmits failures
or uncertain outcomes. Outputs still need visual/identity review and explicit import.
signature: (project_id: str, kind: str, parameters: dict, assets: dict[str, str], request_id: str, endpoint: str = 'http://127.0.0.1:8189', native_endpoint: str = 'http://127.0.0.1:8000') -> dict

name: create_composition
description: Create an original responsive composition. Use for CSS layout and fully shaped multilingual text.
signature: (project_id: str, name: str = 'composition', width: int = 1280, height: int = 720, fps: int = 30, frames: int = 90) -> dict

name: save_composition
description: Validate/save a composition with a revision guard and history. Null revision means create only.
signature: (project_id: str, path: str, document: dict, revision: str | None) -> dict

name: inspect_composition
description: Preview actual layout, font loading, grapheme ranges and overflow at a viewport size. Runs trusted declared plugins.
signature: (project_id: str, path: str, frame: int = 0, width: int | None = None, height: int | None = None) -> dict

name: render_composition
description: Render a responsive composition offline with deterministic seeking checks. Returns a normal timeline clip.
signature: (project_id: str, path: str, width: int | None = None, height: int | None = None, video: bool = True) -> dict

name: list_plugins
description: Load trusted project plugin manifests; list actual components, effects, operators and parameter contracts.
signature: (project_id: str, manifests: list[str] | None = None) -> dict

name: run_plugin_operator
description: Run an original plugin operation as a validated, deterministic proposal; never saves. core/batch supports atomic do/ops-style document changes. Save with the returned before_revision through save_composition/save_timeline.
signature: (project_id: str, operator: str, document: dict, parameters: dict | None = None, manifests: list[str] | None = None, kind: Literal['composition', 'timeline'] = 'composition') -> dict

name: create_animation_kit
description: Create an editable original Blender animation starter and display atlas. No render/download. Existing paths are never overwritten. Read the animation guide; customize the scene for the brief.
signature: (project_id: str, directory: str = 'animation', width: int = 640, height: int = 360, fps: int = 30, frames: int = 60) -> dict

name: build_display_atlas
description: Create frame-indexed RGB LED masks from text cues (animation guide). Returns atlas/tiles/receipt. Limited original dot glyphs; use compositions for shaped multilingual text.
signature: (project_id: str, document: dict) -> dict

name: synthesize_score
description: Render an original deterministic local oscillator/noise score from explicit notes. No AI model or paid service. Returns WAV plus reproducible recipe and preview_audio.
signature: (project_id: str, document: dict) -> dict

name: assemble_blender_clips
description: Validate ordered project-relative Blender receipts and return a timeline proposal with frame hashes. Reject missing frames, dimensions/fps drift and (by default) source-range gaps. Does not save the project timeline.
signature: (project_id: str, receipts: list[str], contiguous: bool = True) -> dict

name: analyze_render_motion
description: Measure decoded-frame optical flow and candidate judder/stalls, excluding planned cuts. source is a local video; thresholds use source pixels/frame. Requires vision extra. Analysis only; never interpolates or revises the video.
signature: (project_id: str, source: str, cuts: list[int] | None = None, work_width: int = 480, moving: float = 1.5, ratio: float = 2.2, stall: float = 0.25) -> dict

name: analyze_camera_motion
description: Analyze evaluated camera_samples from blender_helpers: speed, aim jolts and rotational shutter streak estimates. Includes constraints; not a full image-space blur or aesthetic verdict.
signature: (project_id: str, document: dict, jolt_threshold: float = 2500, jolt_ratio: float = 3) -> dict

name: create_webgl_kit
description: Create an original editable JavaScript/Three.js scene, cut-safe camera schedule and animated display atlas. No render or download; existing paths preserved. Read webgl guide and customize for the brief. Uses the bundled WebGL renderer instead of Blender.
signature: (project_id: str, directory: str = 'webgl', width: int = 640, height: int = 360, fps: int = 30, frames: int = 60) -> dict

name: assemble_render_clips
description: Assemble ordered WebGL or Blender receipt paths into a validated timeline proposal. Checks frame files, dimensions/fps, source/renderer hashes and contiguous ranges. Set contiguous=false for independent shots or mixed renderers. Does not save the timeline.
signature: (project_id: str, receipts: list[str], contiguous: bool = True) -> dict
